name: The Strokes

whyMatters.en: NYC five-piece whose Is This It (2001) reset early-2000s indie toward compressed garage-pop and leather-jacket cool after nu-metal radio.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约五人组：Is This It（2001）在 nu-metal 电台之后，把 2000 年代初 indie 扳向压缩车库流行与皮衣酷感。

note.zh: Room on Fire 双吉他精度。

interviewQuotes.text: We just wanted to make cool music.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Julian Casablancas

lyricQuotes: Last night she said, oh baby I don't know

shortBio.en: Casablancas-led post-punk revival; Last Nite is the debut-era hook.
shortBio.zh: Casablancas 领衔的后朋克复兴；Last Nite 是出道期钩子。

body.en:
Formed 1998. Is This It and Room on Fire fix Julian’s half-spoken vocal, interlocking Valensi/Hammond guitars, Fraiture bass, Moretti drums—lo-fi sheen as aesthetic.

Last Nite (2001) and Reptilia (2003) are the citation singles. UK/US indie boom follows their template for several years.
body.zh:
1998 年组建。Is This It 与 Room on Fire 定型 Julian 半说唱人声、Valensi/Hammond 交织吉他、Fraiture 贝斯、Moretti 鼓——把 lo-fi 光泽当美学。

Last Nite（2001）与 Reptilia（2003）是引用单曲。此后数年英美 indie 热潮跟随其模板。

title.zh: nu-metal 之后的车库流行重置

body.en:
The Strokes matter as a format reset: short songs, dry production, NYC cool, post-punk guitar chatter against early-2000s heavy radio.

Is This It timing is half the story.
body.zh:
The Strokes 要紧处是格式重置：短歌、干制作、纽约酷感、后朋克吉他碎语，对位 2000 年代初重型电台。

Is This It 的时机是故事的一半。

body.en:
Stones-ish guitar figure, Casablancas vocal fry, tight runtime—2001 indie radio object.

Accessible entry to the album’s cool.
body.zh:
偏 Stones 的吉他音型、Casablancas 声带摩擦、紧时长——2001 indie 电台对象。

专辑酷感的易入口。

body.en:
Interlocking parts, urgent vocal—Room on Fire precision.

Shows the band as arrangement, not only image.
body.zh:
交织声部、紧迫人声——Room on Fire 精度。

展示乐队是编曲，不只是形象。

title.zh: 2000 年代 indie 制服模板

body.en:
Leather, skinny ties, compressed mixes—copied hard by peers. Later Strokes records experiment; the debut DNA dominates citations.

Influence is sonic and sartorial.
body.zh:
皮衣、瘦领带、压缩混音——被同辈狠抄。后期 Strokes 唱片有实验；引用仍被首专 DNA 主导。

影响在声音与着装。

body.en:
Early press often mirrors the laconic vocal style. Useful as branding evidence.

Music still judged on the singles’ compression and hooks.
body.zh:
早期媒体常镜像其寡言人声风格。可作品牌证据。

音乐判断仍看单曲的压缩与钩子。

note.en: Garage revival as downtown cool reset.
note.zh: Garage 复兴：市中心酷感重置。

note.en: Tight jeans, tighter songs—indie becomes a look again.
note.zh: 紧身牛仔裤与更紧的歌——indie 再度成为造型。
